name: com.coffeebean.excel
description: Editor-only config-table toolchain for the CoffeeBean framework: Excel reading (MiniExcel) with header detection and aliases, a 27-kind column type table (int/long/BigInteger/decimal/bool/string/char/DateTime/TimeSpan/Guid/enum/[Flags]/byte../ulong/Vector2-4/Quaternion/Color/Rect/Dictionary + array suffixes), strict per-cell type validation, generated enums, and generation of JSON + C# data classes + getters. Generated getters deserialize with Newtonsoft.Json. Editor-only, no runtime code; optionally integrated with com.coffeebean.core for module discovery and version checks.

samples.description: Excel 工具演示：样例配置表 + 生成 JSON/C# 数据类/Getter 的完整流程。
